source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' id="p13", the 'Issues queue' rail card; operator ruling 5.1 (2026-09-07)
notes: dc.html p13 rail card shell: `background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,26,26,.04),0 4px 14px rgba(26,26,26,.06);overflow:hidden`, topped by the ruling 5.1 gradient rule, then `padding:12px 16px 14px`.

dc.html p13 header: title 'Issues queue' `font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7A6E6C;font-weight:700`; total `font-family:Anton;font-size:18px;color:#DC2626` (only when > 0).

dc.html p13 row: `padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06)`; non-zero row label `font-weight:700;color:#1A1A1A`, value `font-family:Anton;font-size:16px;color:#DC2626`; zero row label `font-weight:500;color:#5A6B67`, value `font-family:Anton;font-size:16px;color:#1A1A1A`.

No sub-description line exists per row in the artboard (just label + numeral) — the built component's row.sub field was builder-added content beyond the artboard and has been removed as dormant once unrendered (CLAUDE.md rule: no dormant code), per 'the artboard wins' (README vs artboard) and the harness's own preference for the exact-artboard reading.

The prior build had NO card wrapper, NO SectionRule, and a wrong-direction `border-bottom:2px solid var(--text)` under a 26px title — exactly the divider ruling 4.1/5.1 removes. Rewritten this session to the section-card shell + SectionRule + dc.html's own header/row geometry.

Fixture counts (mounts.mjs ADMIN_ISSUES_RAIL_FIXTURE) match dc.html p13's own example numbers exactly: 489 / 4576 / 6 / 3 non-zero, rest zero, total 5,074 — so this spec measures both the zero-row and non-zero-row colour rules against real numbers, not sample data invented for the harness.
